title: Tag / name pinned clipboard items so that they can be searched for easily
line: Starred clipboard items can be given a name, which is shown above their text and found by the search field.
explanation: The clipboard search only matched an item's contents, and items had no other text attached to them. Someone keeping account numbers or canned replies as starred items had to remember part of the content to find them again. The change adds a name column to the clipboard database (added in place to existing databases, no version bump, so older Plasma still reads it), a "Set name" button on starred text items that opens a small page with a text field, shows the name in bold above the item's text, and makes the search field match the name as well as the contents.

commits.message:
klipper: allow naming starred items so they can be found by search

Starred items are often kept for things like account numbers whose
contents are hard to remember, so searching for them did not help. They
can now be given a name, which is shown above the text and is searched.

BUG: 488293
